mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 650K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, stimulating equity markets and yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling supply chain resilience, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of INDPRO with SPX returns over 20d is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth exceeding 5% YoY, indicating strong demand, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical consumption and stock market correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below its 3-month moving average, the combined effect predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to tightening monetary conditions and subdued inflation.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 1% in 6 months, indicating a rapidly improving labor market, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market improvements and stock performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of UNRATE with SPX returns over 60d is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, combined with housing starts (HOUST) above 500K, predicts strong demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the dual indicators of economic health.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.
